name: NewTelco MainRZ Karlstein
notes: NewTelco describes MainRZ in Karlstein am Main with redundant power from two independent sources at 5 MW; DCD reported the facility opened on November 30, 2023 with 5MW IT capacity. Karlstein am Main is in Landkreis Aschaffenburg.

name: PASS Cloud One
notes: PASS says its existing Cloud One data center is at the Aschaffenburg headquarters and is part of a metrocluster with Cloud One-Two and Cloud One-Two-Three.

name: PASS Cloud One-Two
notes: PASS announced completion of the energy-efficient Cloud One-Two data center at its Cloud Computing & Service Center in Hanauer Straße, Aschaffenburg, supplementing Cloud One.

name: LEW Green Data Center
notes: LEW announced the colocation facility entered operation on May 26, 2025, with four modules, 1,900 sqm and up to 600 racks. Goldbeck's project reference reports 1.8 MW IT load. Public listings place it at Oskar-von-Miller-Strasse 1B, 86356 Neusaess, in Landkreis Augsburg.

name: M-Net Augsburg RZ Steinerne Furt
notes: Eco DC audit identifies RZ Steinerne Furt in Augsburg; M-net's ISO certificate annex lists Rechenzentrum Steinerne Furt 65, 86167 Augsburg for high-availability data-center infrastructure.

name: M-Net Augsburg / Curt-Frenzel-Strasse site
notes: M-net's 2025 ISO 27001 certificate annex includes Curt-Frenzel-Strasse 4, 86167 Augsburg under the certified scope for high-availability data-center infrastructure. Inflect also lists an M-Net Augsburg colocation facility, though with a differing Johannes-Haag-Strasse address, so capacity and exact site identity are left null.

name: Landratsamt Bad Kissingen data center modernization
developer: Landratsamt Bad Kissingen / SVA System Vertrieb Alexander GmbH
notes: SVA case study says the district office consolidated its historically grown data center using a Dell VxRail stretched-cluster system; Kommune21 reported the same modernization on September 14, 2022.

name: Intelsat Kommunications Bad-Kissingen
notes: Datacenterplatform lists an Intelsat Germany data center at Sandflur 1, Fuchsstadt, 97727, in Landkreis Bad Kissingen. Spelling appears as 'Kommuunikations' in the listing; no capacity disclosed.

name: Bundeswehr Rechenzentrum Wildflecken
notes: The district's 2021 release said construction measures for a Bundeswehr data center were being handled by other state building offices; later local press in December 2023 reported the planned Wildflecken data center might be canceled, so current status is unknown.

name: centron Datacenter Hallstadt
notes: Centron states its Bamberg/Hallstadt data center opened in 2014 and that it has operated its own data center since 2008; Datacenter Map lists the Hallstadt site at Heganger 29 with 1.25MW power capacity and operational stage.

name: Stadtnetz Bamberg datacenter
notes: Inflect lists a Stadtnetz Bamberg data center operated by Stadtnetz Bamberg at 28 Margaretendamm, 96052 Bamberg, with colocation and internet access services.

name: T-Systems Bamberg
notes: Baxtel lists T-Systems Bamberg at Gutenbergstrasse 13 as a fully operational data center operated by T-Systems International GmbH; capacity not publicly disclosed in the free listing.

name: TMT Data Center Bayreuth
notes: TMT says it operates its own data centers and offers colocation, managed hosting, private cloud and data-center solutions from Bayreuth; its ISO 27001:2022 certification scope includes operation of IT, cloud, data-center and communications solutions.

name: University of Bayreuth data center
notes: Datacenterplatform lists a University of Bayreuth data center at Universitaetsstrasse 30, 95447 Bayreuth; university IT-service-center documents reference servers housed in colocation cabinets and regional computing resources, but no public capacity was found.
